1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Set a default size if not defined in HTML/CSS
8:   canvas.width = canvas.width || 800;
9:   canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
10:   // Initialize audio context
11:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
13:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
14:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.type = 'sine';
17:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.start();
20:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur / 1000);
21:   }
22:   // Sound helpers
23:   function soundCollision() { playTone(200, 150); }
24:   function soundShield() { playTone(400, 100); }
25:   function soundPowerUp() { playTone(800, 100); }
26:   function soundGameOver() { playTone(100, 300); }
27:   // Create starfield
28:   const starCount = 100;
29:   const stars = [];
30:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
31:     stars.push({
32:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
33:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
34:       brightness: Math.random() * 0.7 + 0.3,
35:     });
36:   }
37: 
38:   // Ship definition
39:   const ship = {
40:     width: 40,
41:     height: 20,
42:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
43:     y: canvas.height - 30,
44:     speed: 5,
45:     moveLeft: false,
46:     moveRight: false,
47:   };
48: 
49:   // Asteroid pool
50:   const asteroids = [];
51:   let asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
52:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
53:   let lastTime = 0;
54:   let gameOver = false;
55: 
56:   // Power‑up (optional, simple shield)
57:   const powerUps = [];
58:   let shield = false;
59:   let shieldTimer = 0;
60: 
61:   // Input handling
62:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
63:     // Resume audio context on first user interaction
64:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
65:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = true;
66:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = true;
67:   });
68:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
69:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') ship.moveLeft = false;
70:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') ship.moveRight = false;
71:   });
72: 
73:   function spawnAsteroid() {
74:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
75:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
76:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + asteroids.length * 0.05; // increase over time
77:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed });
78:   }
79: 
80:   function spawnPowerUp() {
81:     const size = 20;
82:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - size);
83:     const speed = 1.5;
84:     powerUps.push({ x, y: -size, size, speed, type: 'shield' });
85:   }
86: 
87:   function update(delta) {
88:     // move ship
89:     if (ship.moveLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
90:     if (ship.moveRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
91:     // keep within bounds
92:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
93: 
94:     // spawn asteroids
95:     asteroidSpawnTimer += delta;
96:     if (asteroidSpawnTimer > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
97:       spawnAsteroid();
98:       asteroidSpawnTimer = 0;
99:       // occasional power‑up
100:       if (Math.random() < 0.1) spawnPowerUp();
101:     }
102: 
103:     // update asteroids
104:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:       const a = asteroids[i];
106:       a.y += a.speed;
107:       // remove off‑screen
108:       if (a.y > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
109:     }
110: 
111:     // update power‑ups
112:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
113:       const p = powerUps[i];
114:       p.y += p.speed;
115:       if (p.y > canvas.height) powerUps.splice(i, 1);
116:     }
117: 
118:     // shield timer
119:     if (shield) {
120:       shieldTimer -= delta;
121:       if (shieldTimer <= 0) shield = false;
122:     }
123: 
124:     // collision detection
125:     // ship rectangle
126:     const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.width, h: ship.height };
127:     // asteroids
128:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
129:       const a = asteroids[i];
130:       const aRect = { x: a.x, y: a.y, w: a.size, h: a.size };
131:       if (rectIntersect(shipRect, aRect)) {
132:         if (shield) {
133:           // destroy asteroid, shield consumed
134:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
135:           shield = false;
136:           soundShield();
137:         } else {
138:           soundCollision();
139:           gameOver = true;
140:           soundGameOver();
141:         }
142:       }
143:     }
144:       }
145:     }
146:     // power‑ups
147:     for (let i = powerUps.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
148:       const p = powerUps[i];
149:       const pRect = { x: p.x, y: p.y, w: p.size, h: p.size };
150:       if (rectIntersect(shipRect, pRect)) {
151:         if (p.type === 'shield') {
152:           shield = true;
153:           shieldTimer = 5000; // 5 seconds
154:           soundShield();
155:         }
156:         soundPowerUp();
157:         powerUps.splice(i, 1);
158:       }
159:     }
160:   }
161: 
162:   function rectIntersect(r1, r2) {
163:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
164:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
165:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
166:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
167:   }
168: 
169: function draw() {
170:   // Draw starfield background
171:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000010';
172:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
173:   // small twinkling stars
174:   stars.forEach(star => {
175:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
176:     ctx.globalAlpha = star.brightness;
177:     ctx.fillRect(star.x, star.y, 2, 2);
178:     // simple twinkle
179:     star.brightness += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05;
180:     star.brightness = Math.min(1, Math.max(0.3, star.brightness));
181:   });
182:   ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
183: 
184:   // ship as triangle
185:   ctx.fillStyle = shield ? '#00ffff' : '#ffffff';
186:   ctx.beginPath();
187:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
188:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
189:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
190:   ctx.closePath();
191:   ctx.fill();
192: 
193:   // asteroids with radial gradient
194:   asteroids.forEach(a => {
195:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
196:       a.x + a.size / 2,
197:       a.y + a.size / 2,
198:       a.size * 0.1,
199:       a.x + a.size / 2,
200:       a.y + a.size / 2,
201:       a.size / 2
202:     );
203:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#777777');
204:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#222222');
205:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
206:     ctx.beginPath();
207:     ctx.arc(a.x + a.size / 2, a.y + a.size / 2, a.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
208:     ctx.fill();
209:   });
210: 
211:   // power‑ups as rotating shield icons
212:   powerUps.forEach(p => {
213:     ctx.save();
214:     ctx.translate(p.x + p.size / 2, p.y + p.size / 2);
215:     ctx.rotate((Date.now() % 2000) / 2000 * Math.PI * 2);
216:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gold';
217:     ctx.beginPath();
218:     ctx.arc(0, 0, p.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
219:     ctx.fill();
220:     ctx.restore();
221:   });
222: 
223:   // Game over overlay
224:   if (gameOver) {
225:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
226:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
227:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
228:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
229:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
230:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
231:   }
232: }
233: 
234:   function loop(timestamp) {
235:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
236:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
237:     lastTime = timestamp;
238:     if (!gameOver) update(delta);
239:     draw();
240:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
241:   }
242: 
243:   // start the game
244:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
245: })();
